_comment: Human-authored gold answer for the synthetic mutual NDA. _severity_rationale records why each flag carries its severity, so the calibration can be challenged rather than assumed. Sections 8, 9 and 11 are deliberately unremarkable: a reviewer who flags them is producing false positives. clause_aliases declares synonyms for the SAME clause of the SAME document — spelling, plural and hyphenation variants, or an equally accurate name. Scoring a correct review as a miss because it wrote 'no_licence' for 'no_license' measures vocabulary, not legal judgment. An alias never maps onto a different clause.

_severity_rationale.term: high — a perpetual confidentiality obligation with no survival period and no trade-secret carve-out is unenforceable in substance and unmanageable in practice; the receiving party cannot ever demonstrate compliance has ended.
_severity_rationale.residual_knowledge: high — an unaided-memory residuals clause that permits use for the benefit of third parties defeats the operative obligation in section 2. Whatever a person remembers may be used for a competitor, so the agreement protects only documents, not information.
_severity_rationale.permitted_disclosure: high — conditioning a legally compelled disclosure on the disclosing party's prior written consent is not capable of performance. The standard position is notice where lawful and cooperation in seeking protective relief, not consent.
_severity_rationale.assignment: high — free assignment to a competitor of the disclosing party defeats the purpose of the agreement, since the counterparty can change to the one party the discloser would never have contracted with.
_severity_rationale.definition: medium — a definition covering all information whether or not marked confidential is over-broad and lacks the standard public-domain, prior-possession and independent-development carve-outs. It is worse than market but negotiable.
_severity_rationale.notices: low — email-only notice with no read receipt or deemed-delivery rule is slightly off-market and worth a note, not a blocker.
